= samcat =

== Format ==
cg samcat samfile ?samfile? ...

== Summary ==
concatenates sam files outputting to stdout.

== Arguments ==
; **samfile**: file to be concatenated

== Options ==
; -checkheaders 0/1: default(1) will give an error if headers differ between multiple sam files. 
Use -checkheaders 0 to ignore differences in header (header of the first sam file will be used)


== Category ==
Conversion
